project_name: Jujutsu RPG - Interactive Wiki & Game Guide Dashboard
theme: Dark Anime / Cursed Energy Gaming Aesthetic
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / ELECTRIC ANIME (Dark Mode with Neon Cursed Energy Accents)

layouts.navigation: Left fixed collapsible sidebar + top sticky header with global search, language switcher (PT/EN/ES), comparison tray trigger badge & quick stats
layouts.dashboard_home: Bento grid mode B - High Density Analytics with key counters (Total items per category, rarity breakdown pie/bar, top lethal bosses, top SS rank swords, quick jump cards)
layouts.category_views: Top bar filters (search input, rarity badge dropdown, subtype filter, sort options, grid/list view toggle) + Animated Item Cards Grid (3-4 cols) + Side/Bottom Comparison Tray
layouts.card_layout: Glassmorphism card with rarity border glow, category badge, Japanese kanji watermark background, stat highlights, skill count, action buttons ('Ver Detalhes' & 'Comparar')

components_and_features.item_detail_modal: Full-featured dialog with tabs: [Visão Geral, Habilidades / Skills, Mecânicas Especiais, Drops & Fases]. Includes damage/cooldown/stamina progress bars & stat radar.
components_and_features.comparison_tray: Persistent floating bar at bottom when items are selected (up to 3 items of same category). Expands into side-by-side comparative table with visual bar diffs.
components_and_features.no_image_fallback: Styled visual banner with animated aura glyphs, rarity gradient backgrounds, kanji watermark, and item type iconography.
components_and_features.global_search: Cmd+K style modal search bar searching across all 10 categories instantly with live suggestions.
components_and_features.language_switcher: Dropdown menu in header allowing seamless translation between Português, Inglês, and Espanhol for all UI labels and metadata.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure: Use standard .js / .jsx files for React components.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: MUST include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, language switcher, comparison cards, modal buttons). Example: data-testid="search-input", data-testid="rarity-filter-select", data-testid="item-card-detail-button-1".
instructions_to_main_agent.contrast: Ensure header backdrop is bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md (never fully transparent).
instructions_to_main_agent.iconography: Use lucide-react icons for all UI elements.
